features: Four beta-shrunk scoreless probabilities: each opposing pitcher and offense paired per half; lexicographically sort the two pairs for home/away symmetry. League half-inning probability Beta(1,1) supplies the entity prior; it is not a fifth distance coordinate.
distance: Unweighted Euclidean distance on four probabilities; ties ordered by historical game date then exact game_pk
probability: (1 + NRFI labels of 100 nearest eligible prior analogs) / 102; require 100 prior analogs
history: Same season only. Store each analog feature vector as calculated before its own game date; score entire calendar date before adding its labels or updating entity histories.
side_rule: NRFI if p>=0.75, YRFI if p<=0.25; otherwise abstain
tuning: Single prespecified architecture; no grids, threshold search, feature selection or outcome-driven modification
